mapper.select: SELECT id,suppression_end ends_at,suppression_scope scope FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='SUPPRESSION' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(suppression_scope,'$.alertInstanceId'))=CAST(#{id} AS CHAR) AND suppression_end>NOW(3) ORDER BY suppression_end DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='SUPPRESSION' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(suppression_scope,'$.alertInstanceId'))=CAST(#{id} AS CHAR) AND suppression_end>NOW(3)

SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) id,incident_id,escalation_status status,target_order current_target,channel_sequence current_channel,ack_deadline confirmation_deadline,last_error_summary last_failure_reason,last_provider_code exhausted_reason_code,last_error_type notification_risk,owner_team,severity original_incident_severity,acknowledged_at FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_CHAIN' AND alert_instance_id=#{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT target_order,target_type,JSON_UNQUOTE(notify_content) display_name,escalation_status status,notify_recipients channels FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND escalation_chain_id=#{id} ORDER BY target_order
SELECT id,created_at,notify_channel channel,notify_status status,acknowledged_at,escalation_target_id FROM t_alert_notification WHERE alert_instance_id=#{id} AND record_type='NOTIFICATION'
SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) compact_id,JSON_UNQUOTE(notify_content) display_name FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type='ESCALATION_TARGET' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) IN #{id}
